purpose: bank topo.topology_id (retrieval vocab) → catalog composition (templates/sections/<comp>). Retrieval picks a topology_id; this map resolves the exemplar composition the W6 builder adapts. null = no structural match in the 23-composition catalog — the plan row's own composition wins, retrieval supplies evidence only.
note: grid-*-uniform collapses to cards-n (column count is a data-cols prop on the component, not a composition). nav-sidebar has no sidebar exemplar — unmapped by design. Add ids here when new topology_ids land in the bank.
